title: He Survived 60 Hours Inside a Sunken Ship

lines.text: This man survived sixty hours inside a sunken ship.
Nigeria, May 2013. The tug Jascon-4 capsized.
The cook, Harrison Okene, was in the toilet.
It settled on the seabed, about thirty metres down.
In the dark, he found a pocket of air.
About four feet high.
Every breath made that air more toxic.
Eleven crewmates never made it out.
On day three, divers arrived.
Not to rescue anyone. To recover bodies.
On the camera feed, a hand appeared.
Everyone assumed it was another body.
Then the hand grabbed him.
Okene was alive. But he couldn't just swim up.
Days at depth had saturated his body with gas.
A fast ascent could have killed him.
They brought him up into a decompression chamber.
One expert estimated the air turned dangerous around hour fifty-six.
He was found near hour sixty.
They came for the dead and found him breathing.

shots.environment: other:inverted cabin/toilet compartment of capsized tug (room builder, flipped)
shots.description: Cross-section-style interior of a small steel compartment upside down: wash basin and pipes overhead, door frame inverted. Dark water fills the lower two-thirds; a bright lens of trapped air at the top. A faceless silhouette man (char_figure, no coat) floats with head and shoulders in the air pocket, one hand on the inverted basin. A single weak flashlight bobs on the surface, its beam scattering in the water. Frame is mid-story from frame 1; slow push-in starts immediately.
shots.camera: Slow push-in 0.6 m over 3 s, 24 mm, vertical 9:16, figure in upper third, camera roll 180 deg; subtle handheld
characters: okene_silhouette (faceless figure, bare torso, dark grey)
shots.lighting: Single handheld flashlight (spot, warm white 4000K) + very low teal ambient from water volume; deep blacks

shots.description: Night sea surface in heavy swell. Low-poly tug (shipwreck builder, broken=False, length 30, small superstructure, towing winch aft) rolls past 90 deg and over in silhouette against a faint dawn-blue horizon. Spray particles. Map inset slides in top: Nigeria coastline with pin offshore.
shots.camera: Wide, 35 mm, low over the water line, slight handheld sway; hull roll animated over the shot
shots.lighting: Moon/sun lamp very low, cold blue rim light on hull silhouette; storm dark sky

shots.description: Tiny toilet compartment (room 1.4x1.6x2.2 m, steel walls, basin, door). The whole room rotates as the ship rolls; door swings shut; a rush of water enters under the door. Silhouette figure braced against wall. Name card typed on screen.
shots.camera: Locked to room (camera parented to room) so the world appears to tip; 20 mm, medium-wide
shots.lighting: Single ceiling bulb that flickers then dies at end of shot

shots.description: Underwater exterior: inverted tug hull sinking slowly, trailing bubbles, then settling onto a flat silty seabed with a puff of silt. Depth gauge counts 0 -> 30 m.
shots.camera: Slow tilt down following the hull, 28 mm, hull fills lower half on landing
shots.lighting: Dim blue-green ambient fading darker with depth; no sun shafts at the bottom

shots.description: Short inverted ship corridor (corridor builder, 8 m, narrow, doors every 2 m) flooded to near the ceiling; a hand (silhouette) slides along the wall pipes in near-total darkness, then the corridor ends in a doorway glinting with a reflective air surface above.
shots.camera: Camera rolled 180 deg (ship interior upside down: floor lamps/fittings on 'ceiling'); slow dolly forward at head height, 20 mm
shots.lighting: Near black; faint flashlight from the figure's hand, intermittent

shots.description: 2.5D x-ray cutaway: side section of the inverted compartment, water shaded teal, air pocket bright. A labelled measurement bracket draws on between the waterline and the steel overhead.
shots.camera: Static orthographic-looking 50 mm, slight push
shots.lighting: Flat diagram light, teal water, warm air

shots.description: Close on the waterline at mouth level of the silhouette; breath fogs the air; tiny ripples. A red 'CO2 RISING' callout pulses (no invented numbers).
shots.camera: Macro-ish 50 mm at the waterline, half above / half below water split, slow drift
shots.lighting: Weak flashlight bouncing off the water ceiling

shots.description: Wide exterior of the inverted wreck resting on the seabed, completely dark and still; fish_school passes slowly. No bodies shown.
shots.camera: Very slow pull-back, 24 mm, hull in lower third, empty dark water above
shots.lighting: Almost none: faint blue ambient only

shots.description: Hour counter races; then from above, two helmeted divers (char_diver, single tank + surface-supply umbilical) descend a down-line toward the wreck, helmet lights on.
shots.camera: Top-down looking past the divers to the dark hull, 28 mm, slow follow
shots.lighting: Two helmet torches (cool white spots) cutting the dark

shots.description: Rescue diver A swims along the inverted hull, torch sweeping hatches. Card overlay reads like an operations log.
shots.camera: Tracking side-on, 24 mm, diver in middle third
shots.lighting: Helmet torch only

shots.environment: other:helmet-camera monitor view inside inverted compartment
shots.description: Grainy, desaturated 'helmet cam' frame (post: scanlines, vignette, timecode) inside a flooded inverted room. The torch beam sweeps; a stylised low-poly hand drifts into the light at frame edge. Gentle, not graphic.
shots.camera: POV from helmet, 18 mm, handheld sway; compositor adds monitor grain
shots.lighting: Single harsh torch beam

shots.description: Same monitor view: the diver's glove reaches toward the still hand. Slow push. Silence beat at end.
shots.camera: Slow digital push-in on the hand, POV
shots.lighting: Torch beam

shots.description: Real-render close-up: the hand closes firmly around the diver's glove. Torch flares across the frame.
shots.camera: Close, 50 mm, quick snap zoom on the grip
shots.lighting: Torch flare, warm highlight

shots.description: Wide in the air pocket: diver's torch fills the space; the silhouette figure's head above water, the diver's helmet surfacing beside him.
shots.camera: Camera rolled 180 deg (ship interior upside down: floor lamps/fittings on 'ceiling'); medium-wide 24 mm, slow arc
shots.lighting: Torch now the key light; warm rim on the figure

shots.description: Simple x-ray silhouette of a body; tissue fills with small gas dots while a pressure gauge reads 30 m / ~4x surface pressure.
shots.camera: Static, 50 mm, slight push
shots.lighting: Flat diagram

shots.description: Same diagram: an arrow shoots upward; the gas dots swell into bubbles; red X stamps over the arrow.
shots.camera: Static, quick shake on the X
shots.lighting: Flat diagram, red accent

shots.environment: other:support vessel deck at night with decompression chamber
shots.description: Deck of a support vessel at night: a white cylindrical chamber (simple cylinder prop with porthole and hatch wheel), porthole glowing warm. Two helmeted silhouettes close the hatch.
shots.camera: Low angle 28 mm, slow push to porthole
shots.lighting: Deck floodlights (sodium orange), warm porthole glow

shots.description: Horizontal timeline 0 h -> 60 h draws on; marker at 56 h glows red 'CO2 symptoms (estimate)'.
shots.camera: 2D, slow pan along the line
shots.lighting: Dark background, teal line

shots.description: Hours counter slams to its final value over the air pocket; the diver's torch beam steadies on the figure.
shots.camera: Static 35 mm, slight shake on counter stop
shots.lighting: Torch key, teal fill

shots.description: Same composition as S01 (loop match): inverted compartment, figure's head in the air pocket, but now a rescue diver's torch pushes in from below the waterline. Music drops out; hard cut back to S01.
shots.camera: Matches S01 framing exactly at the final frame; 24 mm, roll 180 deg
shots.lighting: Flashlight + incoming diver torch from below

loop_line: They came for the dead and found him breathing.
